heal.name: Heal
heal.synergyNotes: Providing battlefield stabilization, treating lethal caltrop wounds, and countering poisons or diseases.

actions.name: First Aid (Stabilize Dying Ally)
actions.description: Bandage and compress wounds on a creature reduced to negative hit points to immediately stabilize them.

actions.name: Treat Poison
actions.description: Administer antitoxin or suck poison from a wound before the secondary damage takes effect.

actions.name: Provide Long-Term Medical Care
actions.description: Tend to a convalescing patient over 24 hours to double their natural healing rate for hit points and ability damage.
